text.tspan: How deep each device reads: from L1 (signals) up to L7 (the request)
Higher = reads deeper = smarter decisions, but more work per packet. The layer numbers come from the OSI model (1.5).
Cloud has them all in software: route table = router, security group = firewall, ALB = load balancer, Linux bridge = switch.
